candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Essentially flawless: all kanji/kana correct, all furigana captured inline (むかし, やくわり, かちょう, しんしょうひん, あいて, おこ, しゅじんこう, え), word-bank table intact, long blanks represented faithfully. Only minor quibble: multi-line items collapsed to single lines (acceptable in markdown).

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Virtually identical to A in accuracy and completeness; all furigana present, table correct. Blanks rendered slightly shorter than in the image but this is cosmetic. No errors detected in text.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Several errors: ⑦ 腕 misread as 脱 with a spurious comma (料理の脱を、ふるって); ④ drops the particle を (should be をすることになっている) and omits furigana on 新商品; ⑤ omits furigana あいて; ⑧ omits furigana え; ⑨ changes て to で (親から___で一人で). Table puts the first row of the word bank as a markdown header row, misrepresenting the box layout. Uses (1)(2) instead of circled numbers.

rationale: A and B are both near-perfect transcriptions with all furigana, correct kanji, and a faithful word-bank table; A edges out B only because its long underscores better mirror the length of the blanks in the image. C is clearly third: it contains a genuine character misreading (腕→脱), drops a particle in ④ and alters て→で in ⑨ (small textual corruptions), omits several furigana annotations present in the image, and its table formatting misuses the header row.
